component.name: Clippo
component.summary: Clipboard history for COSMIC that never shows a password in full

description.p: Clippo is a clipboard-history manager built natively for the COSMIC desktop, which ships none of its own. A background daemon records every copy; a panel applet and a command-line client read the same history over D-Bus.

It is built around the thing most clipboard managers get wrong. A clipboard history is a list of the last few hundred things you copied, and some of them were passwords, so clippo encrypts its history at rest and never renders a suspected secret in full.

ul.li: History encrypted at rest with SQLCipher, keyed from the Secret Service
Suspected passwords and API tokens shown masked, while still pasting in full
A keyboard-first panel picker with fuzzy search, bindable to a global shortcut
Text, HTML, file lists and images, each stored with every flavour it was copied in
Pinned entries, exempt from retention and from clearing the history
A complete command-line client, so every feature is scriptable

description.p: First release: capture, encrypted storage, the daemon and its D-Bus interface, the command-line client, secret detection and masking, and the panel applet.
